title: DSD curation package
description: A batch of newly created content attached to inventory entries that already exist. Definitions, Vietnamese translations and examples only. AI-origin records require an audited generation envelope; pronunciation and audio remain separate workflows. scripts/dsd/curation.ts additionally checks source scopes, actors, rights evidence and approved tools against the committed registries.

batch_id.description: Batch identifier, stored on every row so a whole batch can be traced or withdrawn.

declaration_id.description: Signed clean-room declaration covering this batch. Required: authorship without a declaration is an assertion nobody can audit.

generation.description: Auditable facts for an AI-generated batch. Required by the runtime validator whenever any record has an AI origin actor.

generator_tool_revision.description: Must equal the approved revision in the tool registry.

generated_source_id.description: Approved source ID carried by every AI-origin record in this batch.

runtime_model_id.description: Exact provider model ID when exposed; otherwise an explicit undisclosed sentinel rather than a guessed model name.

contributorId.description: Pseudonymous contributor ID from data/dsd/contributor-registry.json. Names never enter Git.

authorship.description: Every record carries its own human-author or AI-origin actor, source and rights evidence. Each claim must stand on its own.

source_id.description: Source ID from data/dsd/source-registry.json, which must be approved for this record's scope: 'definition', 'translation' or 'example'.

rights_evidence_id.description: Must equal the human actor's IP-assignment evidence or the AI actor's output-rights evidence in the registry.

dsd_entry_id.description: UUID of an existing dsd_entries row. Content attaches to inventory; it never creates it, and no legacy identifier is accepted anywhere in this package.

headword.description: Authoring context, never written. Checked against the inventory row at import, which catches senses authored against the wrong UUID.

product_rationale.description: Authoring context copied from the inventory decision, never written.

sense_key.description: Stable key for this sense within the entry. DSD-assigned; never a source sense ID.

definition_en.description: Originally authored English definition. At most 400 characters after normalization — a longer one is two senses.

usage_labels.description: Register or domain labels. Order carries no meaning and does not affect the content hash.

vi.description: Vietnamese rendering of the same sentence. The pair is the unit a reviewer approves and the unit that is hashed.

$comment: Forbidden fields, rejected by name with an explanatory error: word_id, definition_id, source_definition_id, source_sense_id, example_id, legacy_id, oewn_sense_id, ngsl_rank, frequency_rank, ipa, pronunciation, audio_url, audio_path, status, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, approved_by, approved_at, published_at, revision, supersedes_id, provider, model, prompt, temperature, api_key, generated_by, similarity_score, similarity_source. Curation imports drafts; review state and publication are set by the review workflow, by a different person, under a CHECK constraint that refuses self-review.
